fusions.name: Spellgnaw
fusions.desc: Sends a crackling locust into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Muddled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unravelled Glyphs
fusions.desc: The swarm tears at every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 12 damage with a 50% chance to leave them [Shocked] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Swallowed Spells
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, the swarm swallows 30% of the elemental damage you take and returns it to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Crumbs of Spent Power
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, the swarm gathers back 4 of it. Once every 6 seconds.
